data.name: Melchioron
data.gender_notes: Melchioron is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew words melkheh (king) and yarach (to give). Melchioron was one of the three magi, also known as the Three Wise Men, who visited the baby Jesus after his birth. They brought gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh, symbolizing kingship, divinity, and death. The name Melchioron carries the meaning “Kings, gifts, wise men” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Melchioron usually hope their child will grow to embody kings, gifts, wise men and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wisdom, knowledge, and the gifts brought to Jesus by the Magi.
data.etymology: Melchioron belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Kings, gifts, wise men.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Melchioron total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: מלכיאורון
in_hebrew.meaning: מלך האור, מלכיאור הוא שם של אחד מהמלכים החכמים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מלכיאורון הוא שם שמורכב מ'מלך' ו'אור', ומשמעותו הוא מלך האור. בשורש העברי, 'מלך' מתייחס לשליט או למלך, ו'אור' מתייחס לאור או לאור ה'. השם מלכיאורון הוא אחד משמותיהם של שלוש המלכים החכמים, הידועים גם כשלוש החכמים, שהגיעו לבקר את ישוע המשיח לאחר לידתו, על פי המסורת הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Μελχιορών
in_greek.meaning: Βασιλιάς του φωτός, ένας από τους τρεις μάγους
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μελχιορών προέρχεται από τις εβραϊκές λέξεις 'מלך' (βασιλιάς) και 'אור' (φως). Οι τρεις μάγοι, γνωστοί και ως οι τρεις σοφοί, ήρθαν να προσκυνήσουν τον Ιησού Χριστό μετά τη γέννησή του, σύμφωνα με την παράδοση της Εκκλησίας. Ο Μελχιορών είναι ένας από αυτούς τους μάγους και το όνομά του αντανακλά την πνευματική του σημασία ως βασιλιάς του φωτός.

in_latin.name: Melchioron
in_latin.meaning: Rex lucis, unus ex tribus sapientibus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Melchioron derivatur ex hebraeis vocibus 'מלך' (rex) et 'אור' (lux). Melchioron est unus ex tribus sapientibus, qui venerunt adorare Jesum Christum post eius nativitatem, secundum traditionem ecclesiasticam. Nomen eius reflectit spiritualem significationem eius ut rex lucis.

in_english.name: Melchioron
in_english.meaning: King of light, one of the three wise men
in_english.long_meaning: The name Melchioron is derived from the Hebrew words 'מלך' (king) and 'אור' (light). Melchioron is one of the three wise men, also known as the Magi, who came to worship Jesus Christ after his birth, according to Christian tradition. The name reflects his spiritual significance as a king of light, symbolizing wisdom, guidance, and illumination.

celebrity_usage: Melchior (name of a king in the opera 'Rigoletto')
data.cultural_impact: The name Melchioron is a reflection of the rich history and traditions of Christianity. It is a reminder of the Magi's important role in the Nativity story and the impact they had on the spiritual journey of Jesus.
data.spiritual_significance: Melchioron holds a significant spiritual meaning as a symbol of the divine nature of Jesus. The name brings to mind the fulfillment of ancient prophecies and the universal recognition of Jesus as the Son of God. It also represents the connection between the secular and the sacred. The magi's acceptance of the newborn king, represented by their gifts, provides a powerful image of the spiritual journey and the recognition of the Divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Melchior, not Melchioron, is a name of one of the Magi in the Nativity story. It means "king of light" or "king of the East." In a spiritual sense, Melchior represents the wisdom and knowledge that comes from seeking the truth and the light in life.

biblical_reference.note: Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name Melchioron is associated with one of the three wise men who visited Jesus after his birth, as per Christian tradition.

historical_references.reference: Melchior, one of the Three Wise Men who visited the infant Jesus, is described in the Gospel of Matthew as coming from the East and bringing gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh. This Melchior is believed to have been a Magus, a member of a Persian priestly class.

The name Melchior is also associated with Melchior von Mailand, a 15th-century Italian painter who is considered one of the earliest representatives of the Quattrocento period. He is known for his Madonna and Child paintings, which often depict the infant Jesus with the Three Wise Men.

In modern usage, it is commonly seen in fantasy literature and role-playing games as the name of wise, powerful, or mystical beings. For instance, in literature, an author might create a character named Melchioron who is a powerful sorcerer or a wise sage. In role-playing games, Melchioron might be the name of a powerful non-player character or a player character's alter ego. On social media platforms like blogs and forums, fans of fantasy literature and role-playing games might use the name 'Melchioron' in their avatars or pseudonyms. The honorific usage of 'Melchioron' in formal settings is less common, but it can be seen in certain contexts, such as addressing a high-ranking cleric or a distinguished scholar with the title 'Melchioron'.

name_in_real_life.story: Thomas Melchioron, a minister in Athens, Greece, shares that their name Melchioron meaning "Kings, gifts, wise men" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
